textRuns.value: Can a model that sees more than the fire-weather index locate the next day's ignitions? Pre-registered test on Spain, Portugal and Greece, 0.25 degree cells, trained on 2019-2021, tested on 2022 and 2023. Criterion frozen before training: Brier score 10 % better and PR-AUC 0.05 higher than the fire-weather-only model, in both years. 2023 passes; 2022 falls short on the Brier gain. Verdict: reduced GO, and the operational forecast was dropped.
